rules.statement: A donor may reserve the right to revoke a deed of gift, and can subsequently revoke it without assigning or proving any reason.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) Although ordinarily a deed of gift is irrevocable by the donor never the less it is competent for the donor to reserve to himself the right of revocation in which event the donor can by executing a subsequent deed of revocation and without assigning or proving any reason in a court of law revoke the earlier deed of gft. (2) It is legitimate for a donor to reserve a right of revocation in a donatio propter nuptias

rules.statement: A donor may lawfully retain the right to revoke a gift made in anticipation of marriage.
